personality: 2 Material You / Expressive (infused with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces)
personality_one_liner: A premium, intelligent finance companion that feels fluid, vibrant, and incredibly smart, balancing expressive tonal richness with glass-like clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous tonal spacing. Elements group conceptually rather than with hard borders.

do's: Use heavy glass effect (expo-blur) on the bottom tab bar and central + FAB background.
Use glass overlays on hero cards paired with subtle background gradients.
Use glass for sticky header backgrounds when content scrolls beneath.
dont's: Don't apply glass to every single list row or card.
Don't use glass without a translucent tint layer behind text to guarantee readability.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A smart dashboard providing a high-level financial overview and quick access to insights.

states.empty: N/A - Core app dashboard, falls back to zero-state onboarding prompts.
states.error: Failed to load insights. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Large hero insight card at the top (abstract gradient bg + glass overlay + vertical text). Below: horizontally scrolling 'Renewals in 30 days' chips. Followed by multi-column grid of 'Recent Links' and watchlist preview. Sticky bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Subscriptions
screens.purpose: List and detailed management of recurring costs.

states.empty: Illustration of empty wallet with 'No active subscriptions found' and primary CTA to add.

screens.layout: Sticky segmented control (Active / Watchlist) below a glass header. Single column list rows for subscriptions using realistic PNG logos fetched in real-time. Each card isolates its info: Name, Amount, Next Renewal. Bottom padding ensures list clears the tab bar.

screens.name: Smart Inbox
screens.purpose: Triage center for AI-extracted plans, links, and subscriptions.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty tray. 'Inbox Zero! All items processed.'

screens.layout: Tabs for All / Needs Review / Duplicates. List view focuses on direct-action triage controls: swipe to accept/reject or inline buttons (Add/Merge/Ignore). Use confidence-based badges (e.g., '95% Match' in brandSecondary) on each card.

screens.name: Knowledge Graph
screens.purpose: Visual, interactive node graph connecting subscriptions, links, and tags.

states.empty: Add data to see your brain map.

screens.layout: Full-screen canvas area using React Native Skia/Reanimated physics graph (or matrix layout for performance). Nodes are rounded pills or circles. Use floating action buttons for zooming/resetting view. The header should be glassy so the graph flows underneath.

screens.name: Ask AI
screens.layout: Standard chat UI. User messages right-aligned (brandTertiary tint), AI left-aligned (surfaceSecondary). Large, glassy sticky voice input (Mic) FAB anchored to the bottom alongside text input.

screens.name: Action Bottom Sheet
screens.purpose: Central '+' hub to add any type of data.
screens.layout: Triggered by the center tab bar FAB. Uses @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Grid of action tiles: Scan Screenshot, Choose Photo, Paste Link, Add Sub. High visual hierarchy, rounded icons on surfaceTertiary.

hero_abstract_bg.alt: Premium abstract gradient shapes for hero background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette tokens. I've allowed 'Indigo/Purple' since it was explicitly requested, but it's balanced with Mint and Peach to avoid the 'generic AI slop' look.
Implement the 'Material You / Expressive' spacing and radius (rounded cards up to 24pt). Avoid heavy drop shadows; rely on tonal separation (`surface` vs `surfaceSecondary`).
Use glassmorphism selectively but intentionally: the bottom tab bar, sticky headers over scrolling lists, and the central FAB should use `expo-blur`.
For the Smart Inbox, implement inline triage controls (accept/reject/merge) on the cards so users don't have to navigate to a detail screen to process extracted data.
For the Knowledge Graph screen, implement a high-performance visual map. A CSS-Grid/Matrix layout or a Reanimated Skia layout is highly recommended for mobile performance over heavy DOM-based D3.
Ensure all lists have a bottom inset to clear the translucent bottom tab bar.
